findings.description: tests/unit/task-archive-routes.test.ts line 20 uses `plan: []` but PipelineTask defines the field as `planSubtasks: PlanSubtask[]`. This causes `bun run lint` (tsc --noEmit) to exit with code 2. The spec criterion 'Type check / build command passes' is not met.

README.md has no 'Archiving tasks' section. The spec explicitly requires a one-paragraph section describing the UI (archive/restore/delete buttons) and the archive endpoints (POST /archive, POST /unarchive, DELETE /:id). The criterion is entirely unmet.

projections.ts has no comment documenting that `archived_at` is projection state (not event-sourced) and that rebuildProjectionsFromEvents() therefore leaves it as NULL for all tasks. The spec explicitly asks for this comment.
